title: Checkout Method Eligibility and Line Limits - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders offer six fulfillment methods, listed here in their catalog order. Each method can be chosen only where its entry conditions hold, and each sets the largest quantity of one item on one order and whether frozen or refrigerated food can be ordered with it.

| # | Fulfillment method | Entry conditions | Largest quantity of one item on one order (units) | Frozen or refrigerated food can be ordered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Standard Ship-to-Home | Ships to a residential or business address; frozen food is excluded | 24 | No |
| 2 | Expedited Ship-to-Home | Ships to a residential or business address; frozen food and large furniture items are excluded | 24 | No |
| 3 | Buy Online Pick Up In Store | The pickup store has the items in stock | 24 | Yes |
| 4 | Curbside Pickup | The pickup store has the items in stock | 24 | Yes |
| 5 | Same-Day Delivery | The delivering store has the items in stock; merchandise subtotal of at least $35.00 | 12 | Yes |
| 6 | Large Item Freight Delivery | Requires large furniture items; ships to an address with ground-floor or elevator access | 2 | No |

**Matrix notes**

- Frozen food can be carried by Buy Online Pick Up In Store, Curbside Pickup and Same-Day Delivery only.
- Same-Day Delivery allows at most 12 units of one item per line; Large Item Freight Delivery at most 2; every other method 24.
- Large furniture items are the item category that Large Item Freight Delivery requires; Expedited Ship-to-Home excludes them.
